name: @livekit/local-inference
description: LiveKit on-device inference (end-of-turn detector + streaming VAD)
author: LiveKit

scripts.//install: No-op to suppress pnpm 9's implicit `node-gyp rebuild` (pnpm ignores `gypfile: false`).
scripts.build:dev: pnpm prebuild-blob && node-gyp rebuild && node test/smoke.js
scripts.prebuildify: pnpm prebuild-blob && prebuildify --napi --strip --target node@22.0.0 --target node@20.0.0 --target node@18.0.0 && node test/smoke.js
